dct_description_sm: The dataset "Ethiopia - Rivers" represents the river lines of Ethiopia, sourced from DIVA-GIS. It provides vector data indicating the locations of rivers across the country. The dataset falls under the Inland Waters category, which includes features related to drainage systems, water utilization plans, and hydrological characteristics. The data is available for public access. The dataset was published on August 14, 2017, and it can be downloaded or viewed through the ICPAC Geoportal.
